def g5(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
print("P3 now:", ''.join(g5(current_frame,52,36)))
# move cursor left 3 to position 0
for _ in range(3):
    action(['LEFT'])

    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return sorted(set(c for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='W']))
print("cursor cols:", whites(current_frame))
seq=[g5(current_frame,52,15)]
for i in range(7):
    action(['UP'])
    seq.append(g5(current_frame,52,15))
    if last_action_result.get('done'): break
for i,g in enumerate(seq): print(i,''.join(g))
</parameter>
